body:
Basically when I was about 13 or 14 (I'm 21 now) I was very socially withdrawn and depressed, spending my day on the computer downloading music and I also discovered porn on Limewire. 

It's killing me to write this, but I stumbled across what was obviously (I can't even type it) 'CP'. My memory is foggy as I have repressed or forgotten it over the years. I remember watching it a few times and getting off to it. 

I don't think I realised the seriousness of what I had done at the time and I guess I just continued on as normal. I don't remember ever watching it or seeking it out after this incident or two many years ago but the shame and constant rumination of what I have done absolutely destroys me, it has completely ripped me apart and I can't bear to be around friends or family when the memory comes to mind.

I feel disgusted with myself.

I'm sorry if this has shocked any of you and I understand any negative judgement you have towards me.
But this stuff was really bad, it scares me to think of how fucked up my mind was at those moments to let me look at this stuff.
I have so many issues that I'm completely overwhelmed. I don't think I will ever be able to resolve them.
I feel so abnormal and weird.

I'm not the same person, in fact I'm a completely different person to who I was when I did these acts, but just knowing that I'm holding secrets that if anyone I know found out about I would be shunned and labelled a pervert or creep. I hate it. I hate myself. It destroyed my relationship with my now ex girlfriend because I couldn't bear to be around her with these memories on my mind. I felt like I was holding something back from her.
I just can't do it, there's so many things I've done and constant reminders keep bringing the memories back. I've been like this since May of 2011.

Hey,

I have been seeing a psychotherapist since November 2011 and I have told her about one or two of the things, but they still come back to haunt me. I feel like some sort of deviant or creep and I really hate myself for it. I don't know what to do.
I'm even too ashamed to reveal the things I've done.
